what: Cenovus Energy is a Canadian integrated oil company. It produces oil sands and conventional crude in Alberta, and refines it in Canada and the United States, so it earns both the production and the refining margin.
customers: Refiners and crude buyers in North America, and fuel distributors through its Canadian refineries and retail network.
money: oil sands, conventional oil and offshore production
moat: Long-life oil sands reserves with low decline rates, paired with refining capacity that is often worth most when crude prices are weakest.
risks: US refineries have had repeated operational problems
Canadian heavy crude discounts affect realised prices
Revenue has fallen about 10% a year over three years with oil prices
Analyst coverage here is thin, with only two estimates
opportunities: Debt has fallen substantially, allowing larger buybacks
Analysts see about 38% upside from current levels
The Trans Mountain pipeline expansion improves access to Pacific markets
watch: US refinery utilisation and net debt.
